title: The family
about: Words for the people in your family: parents, children, grandparents, uncles, aunts, cousins, nieces and nephews. Also how to ask about someone's family and how to say you are an only child.

parts.title: Common mistakes
parts.note: Кажуть my/his wife (одна), але our/their wives (багато). Щоб сказати, чий це родич, додай 's: Taras's wife, my brother's wife. Якщо родич спільний у двох людей, 's ставлять тільки після другого імені: Tom and Lily's mum. Parents — тільки мама й тато; relatives — усі родичі разом (тітки, дядьки, двоюрідні брати й сестри, бабусі й дідусі…). Cousin — і двоюрідний брат, і двоюрідна сестра.

rows: мій двоюрідний брат / моя двоюрідна сестра
Скільки в тебе братів і сестер?
How many brothers and sisters have you got?

items.meaning: all the people in your family: aunts, uncles, cousins, grandparents and others
items.example: We visit our **relatives** in Lviv every summer.
more: Lots of **relations** came to Grandma's birthday party.
Have you got any **relatives** in another country?
items.watchOut: Родичі — relatives або relations. Не плутай з parents: parents — це тільки мама й тато.

items.meaning: sons and daughters; also young boys and girls
items.example: My parents have two **children**: me and my brother.
more: Our neighbours' **children** play football in the yard every evening.
How many **children** are there in your class?
items.watchOut: Однина — child /tʃaɪld/, множина — children /ˈtʃɪldrən/: інший звук і закінчення -ren. Не кажи childs.

items.meaning: the man a woman is married to
items.example: Mum's friend came to dinner with her **husband**.
more: Mrs Petrenko and her **husband** have a small café near the station.
My sister's **husband** is from Canada.
items.watchOut: Українське «чоловік» — це і man, і husband. «Мій чоловік» (у шлюбі) — my husband, а не my man.

items.pattern: my / his wife · our / their wives
items.meaning: the woman a man is married to
items.example: Our neighbour and his **wife** have got a big dog.
more: My uncle met his **wife** at university.
The players came to the match with their **wives** and children.
items.watchOut: Множина — wives (f змінюється на v): one wife, two wives. «Жінка» в значенні «дружина» — wife, а не woman.

items.meaning: your male parent
items.example: My **father** teaches history at a school.
more: Ask your **dad** if you can come to the cinema with us.
Sofia's **father** is a taxi driver.
items.watchOut: Удома частіше кажуть Dad: Dad, can you help me? Слово father звучить офіційніше.

items.meaning: your female parent
items.example: My **mother** speaks three languages.
more: **Mum**, where are my football boots?
Tom's **mother** makes great pizza.
items.watchOut: Британською — Mum, американською — Mom. Коли Mum вживають як ім'я (Mum, I'm home! / Ask Mum.), пишуть з великої літери; після my — з малої: my mum.

items.meaning: your mother and father
items.example: My **parents** are taking us to the mountains this summer.
more: Do your **parents** let you stay up late at weekends?
Lena lives with her **parents** and her grandma.
items.watchOut: Parents — тільки мама й тато. Тітки, дядьки, двоюрідні брати й сестри — relatives. «Мої родичі живуть у Львові» — My relatives live in Lviv, а не my parents.

items.meaning: a girl or woman who is somebody's child
items.example: Our neighbours have a little **daughter** called Mila.
more: Mr Bondar's **daughter** is a doctor.
She's got two sons and a **daughter**.
items.watchOut: gh не читається: /ˈdɔːtə/.

items.meaning: a boy or man who is somebody's child
items.example: Their **son** plays the guitar in a band.
more: My cousin has a baby **son**.
Mrs Hill's **son** is in my class.
items.watchOut: Son звучить так само, як sun (сонце): /sʌn/. Не вимовляй «сон».

items.pattern: an older / a younger / a little sister
items.meaning: a girl or woman who has the same parents as you
items.example: My **sister** is two years older than me.
more: My little **sister** loves drawing horses.
Kate and her **sister** both play the piano.
items.watchOut: Рідна сестра — sister. Двоюрідна сестра — cousin, а не sister.

items.pattern: an older / a younger / a big / a little brother
items.meaning: a boy or man who has the same parents as you
items.example: My little **brother** is learning to swim.
more: Mila and her **brother** go to the same school.
I've got two older **brothers**.
items.watchOut: Двоюрідний брат — cousin, а не brother. Старший брат — зазвичай older brother або big brother.

items.meaning: the father of your mother or father
items.example: My **grandfather** was a train driver.
more: **Grandad** is teaching me to play chess.
Lily's **grandfather** grows tomatoes in his garden.

items.meaning: the mother of your mother or father
items.example: My **grandmother** lives next door to us.
more: **Grandma** always has sweets in her bag.
My **grandmother** can speak Polish.

items.meaning: your grandmother and grandfather
items.example: My **grandparents** have got a house by the sea.
more: We usually spend New Year with my **grandparents**.
Do your **grandparents** live near you?
items.watchOut: Бабуся й дідусь разом — одне слово grandparents. А всі онуки (онуки й онучки) разом — grandchildren.

items.meaning: the daughter of your son or daughter
items.example: Grandma took her **granddaughter** to the theatre.
more: My grandad says I'm his favourite **granddaughter**.
Their **granddaughter** is learning to ride a horse.
items.watchOut: Пишеться з двома d: grand + daughter. Вимовляють /ˈɡrændɔːtə/.

items.meaning: the son of your son or daughter
items.example: Mrs Hill's **grandson** comes to see her every Sunday.
more: Grandad and his **grandson** went fishing on the lake.
Her **grandson** is in the school football team.

items.meaning: the brother of your mother or father, or your aunt's husband
items.example: My **uncle** lives in Canada.
more: **Uncle** Bob always brings us presents.
My **uncle** is only five years older than me.
items.watchOut: Звертаючись, кажуть Uncle + ім'я: Uncle Bob. Uncle — це і брат мами чи тата, і чоловік твоєї тітки.

items.meaning: the sister of your mother or father, or your uncle's wife
items.example: My **aunt** is a doctor in a big hospital.
more: **Aunt** Ira sends me a card every birthday.
We're going to stay with my **aunt** in Kyiv.
items.watchOut: Українською «тітка» іноді кажуть про будь-яку незнайому жінку. Англійською незнайому жінку aunt не називають. Британська вимова /ɑːnt/, американська /ænt/.

items.meaning: the daughter of your brother or sister
items.example: My **niece** is three, and she loves my cat.
more: Aunt Lena bought her **niece** a bike.
I've got two **nieces** and a nephew.
items.watchOut: Niece — племінниця (дівчинка), nephew — племінник (хлопчик). Їх легко переплутати. Niece звучить як piece: /niːs/.

items.meaning: the son of your brother or sister
items.example: My **nephew** is starting school this year.
more: I took my **nephew** to the cinema on Saturday.
Uncle Sam has got four **nephews**.
items.watchOut: ph тут читається як f: /ˈnefjuː/.

items.pattern: my cousin (a boy or a girl)
items.meaning: the child of your aunt or uncle
items.example: My **cousin** Dina and I are the same age.
more: I've got ten **cousins**, and they all live in Odesa.
My **cousin** is teaching me to skateboard.
items.watchOut: Cousin — і про хлопця, і про дівчину. «Мій двоюрідний брат» — my cousin, а не my brother. Вимова /ˈkʌzn/: ou читається як u в cup.

items.phrase: Have you got any brothers and sisters?
items.pattern: Have you got any…? · How many… have you got? · Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
items.meaning: questions you ask to find out about someone's family
items.uk: У тебе є брати чи сестри?
items.example: '**Have you got any brothers and sisters**?' 'Yes, I've got a little sister.'
more: '**How many** cousins **have you got**?' 'Six!'
'**Has** your dad **got any** sisters?' 'Yes, he has. He's got one.'
items.watchOut: Британською кажуть Have you got any…?, можна й Do you have any…? Не змішуй їх: «Do you have got…?» — помилка. Українське «чи» тут — and або or: brothers and sisters / brothers or sisters.

items.meaning: a child with no brothers or sisters
items.example: Max is **an only child**, so he has his own bedroom.
more: Is your best friend **an only child**?
I was **an only child** until my sister was born.
items.watchOut: Кажуть an only child — з an, бо only починається з голосного. Не «one child» і не «alone child».

items.pattern: come from a big / small family
items.meaning: be part of a family with lots of (or not many) people
items.example: Our teacher **comes from a big family**, so she's great with children.
more: I **come from a small family**: just me, Mum and Dad.
Does your dad **come from a big family**?
items.watchOut: Тут present simple: I come from a big family (не I am coming…). Можна сказати й I'm from a big family.

warmup.explain: Родичі — relatives (або relations). Parents — тільки мама й тато, relationships — стосунки.
Двоюрідна сестра чи брат — cousin. Sister — тільки рідна сестра.
Чоловік у шлюбі — husband. Man — просто чоловік, будь-який дорослий.

warmup.uk: У тебе є брати чи сестри?
warmup.explain: Have you got any…? або Do you have any…? Змішувати їх не можна.

warmup.q: Does your mum ___ a big family?
warmup.explain: Бути з великої родини — come from a big family.

A.q: Rita is my dad's sister. She's my ___.
Kira's mum and my mum are sisters, so Kira and I are ___.
Tom is Mrs Black's ___. She's his mum's sister.

B.explain: How many… have you got? — з have.

B.q: 'Have you got any brothers or sisters?' 'No, I'm an ___ child. It's just me.'
My grandad ___ from a big family. He had nine brothers and sisters.
B.explain: Come from a big family — бути з великої родини. Тут минулий час: came.

example.title: Grandma's birthday
example.uk:
Минулої неділі в бабусі був сімдесятий день народження. Усі наші родичі приїхали до неї додому в село.

Моя тітка Ольга приїхала зі своїм чоловіком, дядьком Марком, і їхніми дітьми, Софією та Максом. Вони мої двоюрідні сестра й брат. Моя старша сестра приїхала зі своїм маленьким сином. Він мій перший племінник!

Бабуся була дуже щаслива. «Я теж з великої родини, — сказала вона. — У мене було п'ятеро братів!» Потім дідусь приніс великий шоколадний торт, і ми всі заспівали «З днем народження».
example.en:
Last Sunday was Grandma's 70th birthday. All our [[relatives|a1]] came to her house in the village.

My [[aunt|a18]] Olga came with her [[husband|a3]], Uncle Mark, and their [[children|a2]], Sofia and Max. They are my [[cousins|a21]]. My big [[sister|a10]] came with her baby son. He is my first [[nephew|a20]]!

Grandma was very happy. 'I [[come from a big family|b3]] too,' she said. 'I had five brothers!' Then [[Grandad|a12]] brought a big chocolate cake, and we all sang 'Happy Birthday'.
